mainEntity.name: What materials hold up best for outdoor kitchens in Los Angeles weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Materials should handle sun exposure, temperature swings, and occasional moisture without degrading quickly. Durable stone, sealed concrete, stainless steel, and weather-resistant cabinetry are common choices because they age better outdoors. Countertops and finishes should also resist fading, cracking, and heat damage. In Los Angeles, UV exposure is a major concern, so finishes that look good on day one should also be tested for long-term durability. The right material choice depends on your budget, maintenance tolerance, and design style. A contractor should explain which materials perform best in your specific yard conditions.
